Alps node architecture

Alps is operated by Swiss National Supercomputing Centre in Switzerland. This profile covers the documented compute inventory. Specifications are listed below; anything the operator has not published is itemised in the documented-fields list.

Scope and uncertainty

Alps includes several node architectures. HPL ranking refers to the benchmarked system; the catalog includes all five operator-listed node types. Node specifications follow the documented NVIDIA GH200 Grace Hopper Superchip platform (Superchip module — nodes per system and per-node superchip counts are operator-specific); operator-specific deviations are not published.

Documented fields: 39 / 132

Every field this catalog checks. Fields listed above have a value; the remainder are shown here. A field marked absent is not publicly available in the sources we could verify, which does not mean the hardware is missing. Fields that cannot apply, such as benchmark results for an unranked system, are excluded from the total.
